title: SARS-CoV-2 full-length spike glycoprotein, closed state: all-atom MD
description: All-atom MD simulations of the full-length SARS-CoV-2 spike glycoprotein in the closed state (all RBDs 'down'), protein + glycans only (not aligned). PSF and DCD files are provided. 3 replicas.

system.construct: Full-length SARS-CoV-2 spike glycoprotein homotrimer, residues 16-1273 per chain (chains A, B, C; segments S1 16-685, S2 686-1273), in the closed state (all RBDs 'down'). Non-canonical residues: HSD/HSE neutral histidines, CYP palmitoylated cysteine. Shared trajectories hold protein + glycans only and are not aligned; water, ions and the POPC/POPS/POPI/POPE/CHL bilayer were stripped.
system.glycan_profile: 66 N-glycans (22 per chain: G1-G22 chain A, G25-G46 chain B, G48-G69 chain C) and 4 O-glycans (G23, G24 chain A; G47 chain B; G70 chain C), all on glycan chain G. Residues used: BGLN, AGAN, BGAL, BMAN, AMAN, AFUC, ANE5 (complex, hybrid and oligomannose N-glycans).

data_availability: Trajectories stored on lab storage; available on request

data_location.storage: Amaro Lab GPFS storage, UC San Diego
